acceptanceCriteria: At the V1-1494 harness shape (40k receipts, 15 writers), heartbeat/renew p99 is measured and reduced toward the <1 s target, or the residual is recorded with its cause.

widen, reap and the pool verbs complete under sustained appends without SNAPSHOT_MOVED escaping to callers (bounded retry or equivalent), while CAL-V0-116 rewritten-prefix detection is preserved and tested.
Each remaining #967 proposal (2 remainder, 3, 5) is delivered or explicitly dispositioned in the spec.
body: Follow-up to V1-1494 / PR beamfall/corvint#985 (GitHub #967). The PR moved complete-history audits out of the preparation gate (CAL-V0-263/265): LOCK_TIMEOUT 42/71 -> 0/216, max gate hold 117.5 s -> 1.5 s at 40k receipts, 15 writers, host load ~45. Remaining: (1) heartbeat/renew p99 11.6/14.7 s vs <1 s target, from queueing on the writer lock at 72% gate utilisation; (2) #967 proposals 2 (remainder), 3 and 5 not delivered; (3) owner-orchestrator declined CAL-V0-264 (writer route for widen/reap/pool) to keep CAL-V0-116 rewritten-prefix detection, so those verbs may refuse SNAPSHOT_MOVED under sustained appends - needs bounded retry or a prefix-detecting fast path. Related: V1-1508 (liveness retention), V1-0887 (O(1) liveness).
